items.title: Well-priced IPOs will build long-term market credibility: Kamraj Negi
items.description: Sustainable growth of IPO market will depend on issuer quality and the returns delivered to investors over time, said Pantomath Capital's MD & CEO - investment banking Kamraj Negi.

items.title: India's pharma, healthcare deal volumes rise 23% in Q3 2026: Report
items.description: India's pharma and healthcare sector recorded 87 deals worth $4.3 billion in Q3 2026, as private equity activity surged and public market fundraising gained momentum.
